title: Feedback-enabled magnomechanics in lithium ferrite
summary: Lithium ferrite (LiFe) is a promising material for cavity magnonics because its large spin density enables strong coupling between magnons and microwave photons. Its potential for cavity magnomechanics, however, has remained unexplored. Here, we observe magnomechanical interactions in a single-crystal LiFe sphere using coherent microwave feedback to suppress dissipation of the cavity--magnon polariton.
